reason: A command/route model of frozen closed-loop experts would be underconditioned if arbitrary mid-episode clips have unknown expert hold/history/phase state. Future clock logs alone do not resolve the decision-time initial state.
previous_status: Initial contract preserved actual policy clock events but did not reject unknown initial controller state.
amendment: Primary data requires a collector-attested canonical controller/scheduler/history reset before first native frame, phase0, no previous inference ticks, and reset-contract SHA. Physical global tick is not rebased. Unknown/mid-episode controller state rejects CONTROLLER_INITIAL_STATE.
scope: This resets only the isolated proposed collection episode controller at its normal episode boundary; it does not authorize resetting current production or replaying old once.
future_extension: Continuing episodes require an explicitly history/state-conditioned model interface and new protocol; not currently claimed.
